topic: Forgetting due dates and paying late fees vs one bill calendar with autopay (Mack vs Georgia)

scenes.narration: Late fees are the easiest money you will ever stop losing. Today's training session begins now!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault in a gym tearing up a stack of late fee notices, comic burst banner reads ZERO LATE FEES, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mack and Georgia both pay eleven bills every month.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man mack and woman georgia surrounded by eleven bill envelopes each, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neither is broke, they simply forget the due dates.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a calendar with due dates scattered and unmarked, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Mack pays three bills late most months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man mack looking at three notices stamped PAST DUE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Late fees run twenty nine dollars on cards alone.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a statement line reading LATE FEE TWENTY NINE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: One late payment also drops his score sixty points.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a credit score chart dropping sixty points sharply, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: That costs him a worse rate on his car loan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two car loan quotes, his stamped HIGHER RATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Georgia builds one calendar with every due date.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman georgia filling a wall calendar with every bill due date, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She sets autopay for the minimum on every account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a phone showing AUTOPAY MINIMUM ON for a list of accounts, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Then she pays the full balance manually each payday.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman georgia paying balances in full on payday, marked PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Zero late fees and zero score damage, twelve months running.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman georgia flexing beside a scoreboard reading ZERO LATE FEES TWELVE MONTHS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Autopay the minimum, calendar the rest. Drop and give me twenty bucks!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon man named coach vault, athletic build, buzzcut brown hair, red track jacket with gold dollar sign logo, silver whistle, clipboard covered in dollar sign stickers, fingerless training gloves, sweatband, coach vault blowing his whistle in a gym holding a clipboard reading AUTOPAY MINIMUM CALENDAR THE REST, comic burst banner reads TWENTY BUCKS, kids comic book illustration
